title: Figure 12. Energy Spectrum of the Sun at 5,778 K (Planck curve plot)
description: Graph plotting spectral energy u(λ, T2) on the vertical axis (0 to 1.5×10^6) against wavelength λ on the horizontal axis (0 to 5×10^-6 m), with a red curve peaking near 0.5×10^-6. Captioned "Figure 12. Energy Spectrum of the Sun at 5,778 K." It precedes a section titled "Application of Planck's Law to Hypersonic Vehicles."
